expect_nodes.name: users
expect_nodes.note: `op.create_table("users", ...)` (first argument on the next line) in an alembic revision declares the table: A13.9's migration-DSL scan (`[migrations] dsl framework=alembic`).

expect_edges.note: the revision module touches the table it creates (A13.9). Before A13.9 the only ACCESSES_DATA edge went to the DATABASE node `data_source:sqlalchemy`, the driver, not the table.

forbid.name: sqlalchemy
forbid.note: precision: the ORM/driver name must never be minted as a table entity. It is currently emitted as kind DATABASE, which is correct; this pins that it does not drift into DATA_ENTITY and make the cell look covered.

note: A15.11 zero-everywhere probe, flipped by A13.9 (Alembic op.create_table / drop_table / add_column ... needles). Baseline 2026-09-16 on the installed 0.4.18 wheel: 4 nodes / 4 edges, DATA_ENTITY 0.
